seo.title: Koh Lanta Boat Trips and Transfers | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Koh Rok, Phi Phi and the 4 Islands by boat, the elephant sanctuary, scooter rental and transfers. 4 Islands from 1,000 THB. Desk at 292 Moo 2, Sala Dan.

h1: Boat trips, activities and transfers on Koh Lanta
lead: From our desk in Sala Dan we book Koh Rok, Phi Phi and the 4 Islands, the elephant sanctuary, cooking classes and your transfers.

items.title: Minivan, shared or private
items.text: Hotel to hotel, airports, piers and ferries: Krabi, Phuket, Ao Nang, Khao Sok, Surat Thani, Trang and more. A shared minivan may stop for other passengers.

items.title: Speedboat from Sala Dan pier
items.text: Koh Phi Phi, Phuket, Koh Ngai, Koh Mook, Koh Lipe, Langkawi and more, on the 2026–2027 timetable. Hotel pickup on Koh Lanta is included.

items.title: VIP Taxi Lanta
items.text: Mr. Brown's private minivans across Southern Thailand, for your group only, and taxi rides on Koh Lanta.

rental.title: Car and scooter rental
rental.text: 35 vehicles, from a 110 cc scooter to a 7-seat Toyota Fortuner. Send us the model and your dates.

desk.title: Our desk in Sala Dan
desk.text: Every booking goes through WhatsApp. Boat trips and activities are paid in cash or by bank transfer.

transfersLead: Hotel to hotel, airports and piers by minivan, island to island by speedboat.

faq.a: Send us the trip and your date on WhatsApp. We confirm the price and your pickup time.
In cash or by bank transfer.

faq.q: Do you pick me up at my hotel?
faq.a: Yes, almost anywhere on Koh Lanta. We confirm it for your hotel when you book.

faq.q: What if the weather is bad?
faq.a: The trip can be moved to another date or refunded, when the conditions make it necessary.
